activities.name: Get
activities.whenToUse: Use with a string Plan.Path naming the Token provider and expression, or with both Container and Resource for a Memory.<Container>.<Resource> override. The wrapper trims token brackets, selects the first component, forwards Config and invokes concrete Get. Token_SDA enrollment/ID-state flows may mutate ItemSignal and call Invoke-WriteFile; treat this choice as effectful when that slot is selected.
activities.description: Resolve a token value from a path.

properties.description: Resolve a dynamically selected descendant of the original forwarded configuration.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_Memory only, use a dynamically selected descendant of the forwarded Config when its token expression requires that lookup. This is a dynamic path context, not a fixed child name.

properties.description: Forward the incoming configuration object into the constructed concrete token plan.
properties.whenToUse: Supply the configuration needed by the selected concrete Token provider. The mapped wrapper copies an incoming Config Result into its constructed token plan; provider-specific child fields apply only to their listed adapters.

properties.description: Preserve configuration for a nested dynamic token reference.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_Dynamic nested token references, retain Config so the nested lookup receives the original configuration. This contextual read is distinct from the wrapper's general Config forwarding.

properties.description: Fall back to the content entity type while generating an ID code.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA ID-code generation, provide the content entity type when its other entity-type selection needs this fallback.

properties.description: Use the configured non-artifact master emoji sheet before loading it from storage.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA emoji enrollment, provide a configured non-artifact master emoji sheet when it should be used before storage loading.

properties.description: Use the configured artifact master emoji sheet before loading it from storage.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA artifact emoji enrollment, provide the configured artifact master sheet before storage loading.

properties.description: Resolve the selected emoji sheet from preserved incoming configuration.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA, provide the selected named emoji sheet in preserved Config when that enrollment level requests it. The sheet name is dynamic, not a fixed catalog property.

properties.description: Read configured emoji-set sources during OCIID enrollment.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA OCIID enrollment, supply configured emoji-set sources when that flow reads them.

properties.description: Select entity-specific enrollment, reference-tag, ID, lineage and emoji behavior; current AIContext uses a fixed Artifact path.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA, select entity-specific enrollment, reference tag, ID, lineage or emoji handling where those flows read it. Current Add-SDAAIContext immediately replaces the entity-specific path with fixed Artifact; this field does not select AIContext entity there.

properties.description: Provide the hourly weather observations used for closest-time selection.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA closest-time weather selection, supply hourly observations to compare against the requested time.

properties.description: Build the ItemSignal lookup for the existing primary attribute.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA existing-primary-attribute lookup, name the attribute used to build the ItemSignal lookup path.

properties.description: Select the weather observation nearest the requested time.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA weather selection, supply the target time for the closest hourly observation.

properties.description: Name state resources and reverse-index files, or describe the OCIID write.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA ID/OCIID state handling, name the state resource or reverse-index file used by that branch.

properties.description: Name the state entry used when reading and incrementing the ID index.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA ID-index handling, name the state entry read and incremented by the selected flow.

properties.description: Attach station information to the selected weather result.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA weather output, supply station information to attach to the selected result.

properties.description: Read an explicit user entry or generation directive for ID, reference-tag or OCIID processing.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_SDA ID, reference-tag or OCIID processing, supply an explicit user entry or generation directive when the chosen branch reads it.

properties.description: Use an existing virtual storage path before deriving one from the token expression.
properties.whenToUse: For Token_Storage, supply an existing virtual storage path when that provider should use it before deriving a path from the token expression.

properties.description: Override the token expression with a memory container/resource path when both values exist.
properties.whenToUse: Supply Container together with Resource only when the token expression should be replaced by Memory.<Container>.<Resource>. A single field alone does not trigger this wrapper override.

properties.description: Select the token provider and expression, and describe the resolution in diagnostics.
properties.whenToUse: Supply a string token expression whose first dot-separated component names the registered Token provider. The wrapper trims enclosing token brackets and uses the expression in diagnostics.

properties.description: Override the token expression with a memory container/resource path when both values exist.
properties.whenToUse: Supply Resource together with Container only for the wrapper's Memory.<Container>.<Resource> expression override. A single field alone does not trigger it.

resultNotes: Token_Dynamic: success can have no Result (Null branch)
Token_Dynamic: In/NotIn are overlap tests; not exact-set identity, deduplication or cardinality
Token_Environment: success can have no Result (all scopes return null)
Token_Environment: Only default fallback treats empty string as false and tries the next scope; explicit scope retains empty string
Token_System: Helper strips Environment prefix rather than System; System-prefixed paths can miss
Token_Memory: success can have no Result (path unresolved with no default; warning only)
Token_Memory: Empty inner path invokes misspelled $opSlignal.SetResult and catches technical failure
Token_Storage: Token Get is not intrinsically read-only
Token_Generator: unknown — No generated/navigation/conduction result is asserted from the class wrapper alone
Token_Navigator: unknown — No generated/navigation/conduction result is asserted from the class wrapper alone
Token_Conduction: unknown — No generated/navigation/conduction result is asserted from the class wrapper alone
Token_SDA: success can have no Result (OCIID Config.UserEntry=%S returns without result)
Token_SDA: success can have no Result (EntityLevel unknown entity label sets null without Critical)
Token_SDA: Dispatcher requires at least three path segments. Unknown nonnull Enrollment EntityType has no default and can fail to terminate
